verdict.rationale: Tech Studio explicitly offers 50+ customizable forms & document generators (not static templates), with concrete interactive tools like the Convertible Note Financing Term Sheet Creator and Incorporation Questionnaire (Germany) that require cookies to load dynamically, plus solution tools (Series A Ready, GenAI Policy Builder, EU Startup Health Check). Community comments independently corroborate real-world use of a 'term sheet generator' wizard (tsc.orrick.com) for incorporation. Missing for 10: deeper first-party documentation of the end-to-end assembly/output process and more independent hands-on reviews of the interactive forms themselves (vs. general praise for the static doc library).
